Dialogs.Dialog: Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ What are you doing here？
I'm out for a walk. What about you？
● was just wandering around too, kind of.
Two people meeting by a fountain... There's something nice about that.
Anegasaki
You look so surprised... Was running into me a bad thing？
Not at all! I was just thinking about ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Come to think of it, I think there's a story like that about a fountain abroad.
Huh. So that makes it the ideal spot for lovers to meet, then？
That's right. Mm, the absolute best setting.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
...Hmm？
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
What a coincidence, huh？
Really. Want to go for a walk together？
I'd love to! ...Is what I'd like to say, but I'm out shopping with a friend.
I see. Can't be helped, then.
Yeah. Next time, okay？
Anegasaki
Oh, did you see it too!？
Nah, ● was just about to watch it.
I see. It was so good, I almost want to spoil the whole plot!
Whoa, hold on!
Hehe, just kidding. Have fun watching it!
Hmm, what should I watch...？
My recommendation would be this one, I think.
Huh？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!？
Anegasaki
Good boy. You recognized me just from my voice, huh？
Of course I would. Are you about to watch something too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Nope. Sadly, I already watched mine.
I see. Then let's talk about it afterwards!
Anegasaki
Okay！
Huh？ ...Haha. I didn't expect such an energetic reply.
Hey, stop that! I was still basking in the emotion, so you startled me!
Huh. If it was that good, maybe I'll go see what ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ just watched.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Working out？
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. What about you？
Me？ Just a bit.
？ You could've invited me, though...
If I'm with you, it'd be too fun and we'd goof off. That won't help my diet!
(Makes sense...)
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Working out？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Yeah. Gotta move around once in a while.
I feel like working at Dixie's is plenty of exercise, though.
Hmm, being on your feet all day is tiring, but it's not the same as exercise.
●, you do mess up and run around sometimes, though.
That's true... Hehe, maybe that does count as exercise.
▲主人公＊▲。
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Anegasaki
It should be pretty empty if you go right about now？
You just came out, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ What bad timing.
Yeah. We should have gone together.
How about it？ Even now？
Mm-mm, no can do. I'm totally wiped out. If I work out now, I'll collapse.
I see. Better not push yourself then.
Huh, that's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, isn't it.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Running into you in a crowd like this makes me feel like it's destiny.
Haha, maybe it is.
Jeez, I'm being serious! I mean, even with all this noise, I could still hear your voice.
Really？ Guess I can't say anything weird, then.
Hey! What do you mean 'weird'？ Jeez.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
Shopping by yourself, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Announcement
Paging customer Nene Anegasaki. Customer Nene Anegasaki. Your friend is waiting for you at the 1st floor lost child center.
Huh？ Me!?
The lost child center？
Oh no, looks like I'm past our meetup time... I gotta run. See you later!
Jeez, why the lost child center of all places...？
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s friend sure has a funny way of doing things...)
▲主人公＊▲。
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Anegasaki
Out shopping too？ Maybe looking for a present for your girlfriend？
Well...
Just kidding, just kidding! Don't look so troubled. My friends are waiting, so sorry, okay？
I guess I'll go.
(...Is she expecting something？)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. You came too？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Yeah, it looked fun.
Right？ I was pretty curious about it myself.
We should've come together.
Yeah. ...Then next time, let's come back together, okay？ Deal？
Yeah, let's do that.
So many people... Hm？
Anegasaki
Huh？ What a coincidence.
Are you alone too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Yep. On my way back from shopping. It kinda feels like we were meeting up for a date.
Yeah. Wanna just make it a date, then？
No way. I like savoring dates from the moment we make plans. ...Just kidding, I've got errands to run, so sorry!
(...Too bad.)
Anegasaki
Oh, what are you doing all by yourself？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ Not much, really... What about you？
Just helping a friend out. A part-time gig.
Wait, a job？ What about Dixie's？
Come on, don't make that face. They were short-staffed, so I just helped sell stuff at the venue.
Oh, okay... You had me worried for a second.
Aww, I was so close!
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Anegasaki
Ah... Were you watching？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ totally glued to a claw machine... It's kind of fresh.
...I walked past the shop and made eye contact with that pup. I mean, he's upside down with his neck bent! I just had to rescue him!
So that's why... Guess I'll lend a hand, then.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Are you going to the arcade？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ Yeah, pretty much.
Don't get too carried away and waste your money, okay？
Yeah, I'll keep it in moderation.
That's right, the only thing you should get hooked on is me▼
Haha, roger that!
Now then, what should I start with...？
Taking a lonely young boy into protective custody!
Eh！？
Anegasaki
Fufu, did I startle you？
Oh, it's just you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I'd love to hang out with you, but... sorry, my friend is waiting. Don't stay out too late, okay？
Got it. I'll make sure not to get taken into custody.
Excuse me, sir, can I help you find something？
Um, not really... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!?
Anegasaki
Did you think I was a clerk？
I recognized your voice right away.
Hmm, are you sure？
I told you the truth！
Hmm... I wonder what the difference is between these.
Huh, what are you doing？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Perfect timing. Hey, which one do you think is better？
Hmm... Well, maybe the cheaper one？
Aww, but this one is way cuter.
Then go with that one.
Hey, that sounded completely half-hearted just now!
(Busted...)
(Oh, the new model is already out...)
Anegasaki
You're looking at that awfully intensely.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, fancy meeting you here. Shopping？
Yeah. I want to, but I just can't bring myself to take the plunge.
I get that. They keep releasing new models, after all.
I know, right？ It'd be such a shock if the price dropped right away... What should I do？
(At this rate, she's not gonna buy anything...)
Oh, this is...
Brings back memories, doesn't it？
Huh？ Whoa, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Anegasaki
What's up？ Looking for some oldies？
Not necessarily, but when it's nostalgic, you just gotta pick it up.
I know what you mean. Music really ties back to memories, doesn't it？
Yeah.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
Huh, are you here looking for CDs too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Nope, movie DVDs for me. Doesn't look like they have what I want, though. Maybe I'll try elsewhere.
Oh？ There's another place besides here？
Yep. There's a shop that specializes in scary movies. Wanna come with？
Um... ● was planning to browse around here a bit longer, so...
Hmm-hmm~♪
Anegasaki
Someone's in a good mood.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!? ...Did you hear that？
Yep, I heard that cute little hum♪ Did something good happen？
Yeah. I got to see ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Wha... Oh, come on. You were humming before that! You can't fool me.
(...Didn't buy it, huh.)
Anegasaki
Found you! What are you watching？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ I wasn't really watching, an anime was just on, so I was just glancing at it.
Sure are a lot of cute girls. Which one's your favorite？
I don't really have a favorite or anything...
Hmm... None of the older-sister characters？
...The older-sister one.
Hehe, I totally made you say that.
Eh？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Anegasaki
Ah... This isn't what you think, okay？
Hm, what isn't？
Don't get the wrong idea. I just thought the guy on the edge looked like you.
Is this... a pretty-boy anime？
I'm gonna head out now, see ya!
(The guy on the edge... ●'s not like a prince like that at all, though...)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Doing some shopping？
Well, pretty much.
Make sure you don't waste your money, okay？
I'll be fine. Besides, spending money on hobbies is important too, right？
Well, that's true. As long as you've thought it through. Sorry for nagging.
(It's kinda nice having her fuss over me, though.)
Anegasaki
Welcome home, Master.
Wait, whoa!? ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Surprised？ I looked pretty good in character, didn't I？
If there were a maid that cute, I'd come every day.
Maybe I should change jobs, then.
(She'd be crazy popular...)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Fancy running into you in a place like this.
Yeah, it is. In a place like this... right？
Wait, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you mad about something？
I'm not mad at all？ See you.
(She was definitely mad, wasn't she...？)
Anegasaki
Looking for a new part-time job？
The pay here is better than Dixie's. Want to work here together？
● as a maid？
Geez, why would it be that？ You'd be... what, a butler？ Yeah, I like that!
(She's kidding, right...？)
▲主人公＊▲。
Eh！？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。
Anegasaki
Looks like God really does exist today. My wish came true ▼
Your wish？
Yep. To run into you. And it came true, didn't it？
Haha, then I'd better go thank the gods.
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Out for a walk？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. I came to buy a charm today.
Oh yeah？ A charm, did something happen？
Yeah, a relative is having a baby, so for safe delivery. Well, I'll go buy it.
Oh, then I'll come with...
(...Then again, buying a safe delivery charm together might be a bit much.)
Here to pray, I wonder？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. I just came by on a whim.
Anegasaki
Is that so？ I come make wishes sometimes. About school, work, and also...
Plus？
Hmm, I wonder what？
(...I wonder what？)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Are you bowling？
Yeah, once in a while.
I'd love to join you, but too bad, I have to take off already.
I see. Then I'll practice so I look cool next time I come with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Fufu, I'll be expecting big things~
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, what a coincidence. Want to bowl together if you'd like？
Hmm, I'd love to, but I have some chores to do at home now.
I see. I'll ask you again another time, then.
Sorry. But you know, I like you when you're bowling, too.
(She says that so casually...)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. What are you up to？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Well, my class is having a bowling tournament, so I'm scouting it out.
Oh. So are you in charge of it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
That's right. I've still got a few more places to check, so I gotta run.
Yeah, good luck!
(People really rely on her, don't they...)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Heading to karaoke？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Yeah, pretty much.
Hmm. Meeting up with someone, then？
Uh, I'm actually alone... Is that weird？
Not at all, but I wish I could've joined you. Can't right now, though.
I see.
Sorry, gotta run. See ya!
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Karaoke？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Yeah, I was meeting a friend, but turns out it was a different place.
Wait, are you okay？
We just got in touch. Ugh, I'm such a klutz. It drives me crazy. See ya!
(It's pretty cute when ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ has her clumsy moments.)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. I knew it was you!
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Where are you heading？
Just heading home. I've got some chores to take care of after this.
I see. I thought maybe we could do karaoke together, but some other time, then.
Yeah, too bad. Anyway, bye! Don't go following any bad older girls, okay？
(What does she mean by 'bad older girls'...？)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ What are you doing here？ Are you alone？
I had errands nearby, so I just dropped in. Aren't you by yourself, too？
Yeah, I'm alone too, ●.
Aw, really？ We should've just come together, then.
Man, what a missed opportunity.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Anegasaki
Funny running into you in a place like this, huh？
It's almost like we planned to meet here.
Really. But too bad... The manager just called, so I've gotta go help out now.
Right now？ Want me to come along too, ●？
I'll be fine. He said I can go once things settle down. Well, see you later!
Alright, take care!
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
Whoa, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲! You startled me.
No need to jump like that just seeing your girlfriend, is there？
Well, sure, but aren't you surprised when we run into each other, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
A little.
Right？
But I spotted you first. It was fun watching you for a bit, honestly.
(...What was she watching me do？)
Wanna grab some tea with me？
Whoa, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Anegasaki
Did you think you were getting hit on？
Haha, who knows？
I've got somewhere to be, so I have to run, but... maybe next time I'll really hit on you.
(Somehow, I'm kinda looking forward to that...)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Heading somewhere？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Yeah, just thought I'd grab a drink.
Must be nice. If I had time, I'd join you for one.
No time？
A teacher asked me to finish this month's event schedule by tomorrow, so... Anyway, I've gotta run!
Anegasaki
Grabbing a drink？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Yeah, just taking a little break.
Only up to three refills on coffee, okay？ Too much is bad for you. Oh, tea too! Tea actually has more caffeine, you know. And with green tea...
Alright, alright. If you're that worried, come on in with me.
If I could, I wouldn't be nagging you. I've got things to do, so see ya!
(That went way past big-sis straight into mom mode...)
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
Anegasaki
Ah, ▼! What a coincidence. Grabbing a drink right now？
That's the plan. What about you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Just getting some takeout sweets. I'm on my way out somewhere.
Huh, you can do that here？
Yup, it's pretty handy. See ya!
Anegasaki
If you're going in there, I've got some good info for you.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！
Rumor has it this place actually has a secret menu.
A secret menu？ How do you order off it？
I think there's a password, but, umm... I forgot♪
(Now I really wanna know!)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Getting something to eat？
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Yeah, pretty much.
If it were a little earlier, I would've made you something... Too bad.
Wait, really？ Then I won't eat here!
Sorry, I already promised to eat at my friend's house. I'll cook for you another time, okay？▼
I see... I'll be looking forward to it, then.
(...Man, I feel like I really missed out.)
Anegasaki
Hey, hey？
Eh？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！
Getting food？ If so, there's a dish I recommend. Want me to tell you？
Really？ Tell me!
Ah, on second thought, never mind. I'll make it for you next time, okay？ Hehe, ▼ look forward to it!
(I can't tell if I missed out or got lucky...)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you heading out？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Yep! I'm on my way to a friend's house for a takoyaki party.
Ooh, nice. That sounds like fun.
Are you sure about that？ An all-girls takoyaki party is serious business, you know？
Wait... what do you mean？
That's a girl's secret. See ya!
(...What does that even mean？)
Anegasaki
Eating out all the time isn't good for you, mister.
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I'm a little worried you're not getting balanced meals.
I'll be fine. I make sure to eat my veggies, too.
Really？ Well, as long as you're being careful.
Thanks for worrying about me.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
Oh, are you getting something to eat too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Nope, I was just about to head home.
I see. If you hadn't eaten, I was gonna invite you. Too bad.
Yeah, such a shame... I wish I'd held out a little longer... Ask me next time, okay？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
Hey there, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Hehe, is it fate, ▼？ Or just a coincidence？
Hmm, we got to meet, so either works for me.
Geez, you're so casual about it.
Haha, I guess.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. What are you doing around here, I wonder？
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Prepare to meet your doom!
Eh？
Wait, what does that even actually mean？ Did I use it completely wrong just now？
...Probably.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, what are you doing？
Anegasaki
Huh？ Ah, found it!
Got something？
Yeah, I dropped my favorite hairpin, so I was looking for it.
I see, glad you found it.
The one I was waiting for and the thing I lost both showed up together♪
Anegasaki
Yeah...
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Hehe, it makes me happy bumping into you like this.
Maybe our habits are starting to align, ●.
Maybe so. Someday we might even be able to go on dates without planning them.
(Now that would be something...)
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... I wonder what's wrong, looking around like that.)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. What are you up to？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
Looking for something？
Well, I was with a friend, but we got separated. What should I do？
Huh？ Can't you reach her on your phone？
What!? ...Oh, right, right, I was just about to call her. Really! See you later!
(Did she totally forget about her phone...？)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
What are you up to, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
I'm just heading out to go shopping.
Oh, want me to come along？
Well, I'm with an elderly neighbor today. Helping pick a gift for her grandchild.
I'm sure we'll be fine, but... thank you. Such a sweet boyfriend.
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
Anegasaki
Hehe, I kind of ran over.
You didn't have to rush. Are you okay？
Seeing your face just made me so happy... I'm like a puppy, aren't I？
...A very cute puppy.
Hey, don't get cheeky!
Eh？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
What's wrong？ You seem down.
To be honest, I got into a fight with a friend... I'm on my way back now.
I see... What was it about？
...You.
She said she has no interest in younger guys, and it kind of escalated from there...
(Right... If a friend told ● they're not into older girls, then...)
Anegasaki
I knew you were here▼ Is this what they call intuition, I wonder？
Wait, how did you know？
Your presence, the air... I just had a feeling you were around.
Really？ ● had no idea...
Don't get down over something like that. You're so cute, ▼
(Being by myself is pretty relaxing and nice...)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. What were you daydreaming about？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Oh, nothing much.
See you. Don't go spacing out too much, okay？
(...I take that back. Being with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is way better after all.)
